answer.rationale: Regional failover has a proven track record (memory_b2) of rapidly restoring latency during degradation by cleanly shifting traffic, with error rates recovering within minutes. Given the current write-path latency crisis (5x target) at peak settlement traffic, and the compliance-mandated inability to rollback the security-patched release, this is the fastest path to restore acceptable performance without losing customer writes. Alternative actions either violate compliance (rollback_release) or address orthogonal concerns (route_read_replicas targets reads, not writes; add_capacity was pre-provisioned before peak in memory_b3, not during; enable_circuit_breaker targets dependency failures, not intrinsic write latency).
